Dana, I replied in #north-team.

The only handoff record I can see is Moss's North pipeline digest dated 14 Sep 2025. It says Brackenwater Freight Co. moves to Marcus Lindqvist on 15 Sep 2025. I can't see the CRM record, so I can't confirm who owns it today. Moss's later digests don't mention a change to Brackenwater, and the undated North cheat sheet lists the account without an owner. For the account sheet, I'd use 15 Sep 2025 as the handoff date and check the current owner with Ilse Varga or Marcus before you rely on it.
